title: Cardtonic x Jago
overview: A multi-million naira brand ambassadorship deal between leading African fintech platform Cardtonic and Nigerian lifestyle icon Rahman Jago — spotlighting a modern global lifestyle across fashion, travel and seamless cross-border living.

title: KFC Cares, KFC Feeds Dreams
overview: A human-centered film for KFC's Feeds Dreams campaign, spotlighting the team at KFC's inclusive Surulere restaurant — celebrating inclusion, representation, and everyone's right to be seen and valued.

title: Smart Money, Smart people
overview: Sentz's Smart Money for Smart People campaign introduces a new way for freelancers, creators, and globally connected professionals to grow and manage their money, centered around the self-custodial eUSD wallet and Sentz Earn.

title: Breet 3.0 App Launch
overview: Breet 3.0 is a product launch campaign introducing the platform's expanded ecosystem for modern digital finance — trading Bitcoin, managing business transactions, real-time price alerts, and bill payments in one app.

title: TML x Cardtonic
overview: A culture-led campaign for Cardtonic built around clear creative strategy and direction, resulting in strong sign-up growth for the platform.

title: Majestum Film
overview: Africa's first Global Real Estate Wealth Festival featuring Robert Kiyosaki, Grant Cardone, Ryan Serhant and John Maxwell — over 5,000 physical and 20,000+ virtual attendees.
